title: Product and O3 Curvature-Dual Probes
starting_point: V1692.1 derived Phi_B, Phi_S, and Phi_H4. V1692.2 derives the nonlinear generated-algebra curvature probes Phi_oplus and Phi_O3.
claim_boundary: Mathematical derivation only. No emitter, no simulation, no retained field-law validation.

objects.E_C: transported curvature comparison endomorphism E_C = tau_curv(R_j) - R_i
objects.oplus_p: native product at comparison base p
objects.O3_p: native associator at comparison base p
objects.T_p: retained product test-pair set declared before execution
objects.T3_p: retained associator test-triple set declared before execution

Phi_oplus.definition: Phi_oplus(E_C)(x,y) = W_B[ E_C(x⊕_p y) - D1⊕_p[x,y](E_C x) - D2⊕_p[x,y](E_C y) ]
Phi_oplus.space: V_oplus* over retained product test pairs
Phi_oplus.meaning: measures curvature action on the recombination product law itself
Phi_oplus.important: This is the curvature-side analogue of the product adjoint from V1691.3.
validity: test pairs must be declared before execution
D1/D2 must be derived from the native product kernel
no scalar product-defect projection is admissible

Phi_O3.definition: Phi_O3(E_C)(x,y,z) = W_O3[ E_C(O3_p(x,y,z)) - D1O3_p(E_C x) - D2O3_p(E_C y) - D3O3_p(E_C z) ]
Phi_O3.meaning: measures curvature action on the associator/L3 law
Phi_O3.important: This tests whether loop curvature respects/generated associator structure, not just O3 magnitude.
validity: test triples must be declared before execution
D1/D2/D3 must be derived from the associator generated by op_plus
no scalar O3 norm defect is admissible

rho_alignment.principle: rho_P^oplus and rho_P^O3 must use the same Phi_oplus/Phi_O3 maps applied to event-induced endomorphisms E_event.
rho_alignment.forbidden: repair_event→O3 label-only assignment or dependency_event→oplus label-only assignment

QA_alignment.principle: Q_A^oplus and Q_A^O3 are still the signed boundary trace of exact adjoint stresses Grad_oplus and Grad_O3.

killer_nulls.N_product_scalar: replace Phi_oplus with scalar product defect; must fail schema.
killer_nulls.N_O3_scalar: replace Phi_O3 with scalar O3 norm defect; must fail schema.
killer_nulls.N_product_arg_drop: drop D1/D2 product correction terms; should fail product probe audit.
killer_nulls.N_O3_arg_drop: drop D1/D2/D3 associator correction terms; should fail O3 probe audit.
killer_nulls.N_pair_shuffle: preserve product test pair count but shuffle pair assignments; should fail component identity if law is real.
